Name: Giant Crop Furniture (CP X AT)
Author: famiichikii
Description:
[b][u]*Yo! [/u][/b]

This mod adds the three vanilla [b]Giant Crops [/b]to the game as decorative furniture. It also includes a reskin of each with multiple colour swatches to choose from to best suit your farm and world aesthetic! I'm a big fan of those. (¬u¬)

[b]Now compatible with Alternative Textures![/b]
[color=#fff2cc]
[u][b]*CAULIFLOWER[/b][/u][/color]
>Available from the [b]Travelling Cart [/b]in [b]Spring[/b].
>Costs 10,000 big ones.
>Comes additionally in lore-accurate [color=#f6b26b][b]gold[/b] [/color]and [color=#b4a7d6][b]purple[/b] [/color]as well as [b][color=#fff2cc]white[/color][/b].
[color=#fff2cc]
[/color][u][b][color=#fff2cc]*MELON[/color]
[/b][/u]>Available from the [b]Travelling Cart [/b]in [b]Summer[/b].
>Costs 10,000 Buckaroos.
>Comes additionally in slightly more realistic [color=#b6d7a8][b]green[/b] [/color]and[b] [color=#f6b26b]honey [/color][/b]as well as classic [b][color=#ea9999]pink[/color][/b].

[u][b][color=#fff2cc]*PUMPKIN[/color][/b][/u]
>Available from the [b]Travelling Cart [/b]in [b]Fall[/b].
>Also...costs 10,000G.
>Comes additionally in spooky [b][color=#a2c4c9]ghost[/color][/b] and [b][color=#f6b26b]squash[/color][/b] variants as well as traditional [b][color=#dd7e6b]orange[/color][/b].

[u][b][color=#fff2cc]*POWDER MELON[/color][/b][/u]
>Available from the [b]Travelling Cart [/b]in [b]Winter[/b].
>Guess what? It's 10,000G.
>Comes additionally in dreamy [b][color=#fff2cc]pale[/color][/b] and [b][color=#45818e]deep[/color][/b] variants as well as mystical [color=#9fc5e8][b]glow[/b][/color].

[u][b][color=#fff2cc]*QI FRUIT[/color][/b][/u]
>Available from the [b]Casino anytime[/b].
>Just to be different, it's 10,000 tokens.
>Comes additionally as an adorable [b][color=#6d9eeb]blueboy[/color][/b] and [color=#8e7cc3][b]blushingboy[/b] [/color]variants as well as [b][color=#3c78d8]???[/color][/b].

[color=#fff2cc]All but vanilla sprite work is originally drawn by me. [/color][b]Please ask for permission[/b][color=#fff2cc] before using the sprites in your own mod or anything beyond personal use! [/color]
[color=#fff2cc]If you want recolours or additions, I may be open to suggestions and might update the mod to accommodate the changes.[/color]

[i]This is my first mod so if it's busted let me know and I'll do my best to solve the issue asap T-T[/i]

[b][u]*Mods used in Screenshots (To the best of my memory):
[/u][/b]
[i]>Reshade
>Rustic Country Town Interior
>Ricehit's Chinese-Style Furniture
>DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor
>Nostalgic Furniture Collection
>Farmer's Market Furniture
>Ash's Otaku Bedroom Collection
>Aster's Big Furniture Pack for AT
>Aimon's Tidy Cosy Farmhouse
>Japanese extendable windows
>Japanese walls and floors
>Industrial Furniture
>Japanese Baskets
>FashionSense + Various
>Seasonal Outfits Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
>Vintage TVs
>Japanese seasonal buildings
>Simple Foliage
>Gwen's Craftables
>Pollen Sprites

[/i][b]I'm linking here 6480's amazing giant crop mod: [/b](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221) [i]Because it was a big inspiration for my own sprites and honestly I wouldn't disapprove of swapping my textures for theirs in your personal modpack if you wanted. ;)[/i]
